## What's new in 1.2.0

- Closing the window to the tray no longer shows the "keeps running in the notification
  area" notification.
- Reopening the window from the tray rescans the shared folders and searches the TVs
  again, so new or removed videos show up right away.
- Devices: only TVs can be allowed. Devices that are not TVs (PCs, phones browsing the
  server) are always blocked and have no check box; a device is allowed as soon as it is
  recognised as a TV. "Allow All" and "Block All" only apply to TVs.
